subject: [PATCH] MAINTAINERS: Fix Intel TDX kernel file patterns

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Identified that the current matching approach is case-sensitive and suggested changing it to path-based to correctly match TDX code patterns.

2026-10-30.patch_summary: The patch aims to fix Intel TDX kernel file patterns by changing the matching approach from keyword-based to path-based.
